raw_extraction.description: Ecwid provides a REST API for ecommerce store customization, including managing products, orders, customers, discounts, and storefront customization via JavaScript API. It supports building private and public apps, webhooks for automation, and integration with payment and shipping providers.
raw_extraction.api_breadth: Ecwid API includes REST endpoints for managing products, orders, customers, discounts, and supports JavaScript APIs for storefront customization and automation via webhooks.
raw_extraction.buildability_rationale: The official Ecwid documentation states the availability of REST API endpoints and JavaScript APIs for building apps and automations, indicating that development is feasible.
